subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: What exact provider-reported cost metadata contract should OpenClaw expose for OpenRouter responses, and which runtime, session, status, tool, plugin, or channel surfaces should consume it?
rationale: The fix crosses provider transport normalization, transcript/session persistence, agent runtime metadata, and user/plugin-facing consumption, so source, units, raw details, fallback behavior, and public API shape need maintainer intent.

options.title: Add exact provider-cost metadata
options.body: Additive fields would preserve OpenRouter-reported cost source, units, raw details, and exact per-response values while keeping local estimates as fallback/display metadata.

options.title: Keep estimates as core contract
options.body: Core would continue exposing estimate-based cost surfaces and leave exact provider billing reconciliation to external tooling or plugins.

options.title: Fold into broader usage ledger
options.body: This issue would remain linked to broader usage logging, resolved-model, and auth-attribution work so the observability contract lands together.

recommendation.title: Add exact provider-cost metadata
recommendation.body: Additive fields would preserve OpenRouter-reported cost source, units, raw details, and exact per-response values while keeping local estimates as fallback/display metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across OpenRouter billed-cost reconciliation and the runtime/session usage paths involved in the contract decision.
